question: Which forms does the Lord declare among sages, speech, sacrifices, and mountains?
premises: Bhṛgu is named among great sages.
One imperishable syllable is named among speeches.
Himalaya is named among immovable things.
inference: The verse lists divine self-identifications across categories.
plain_english: Among great sages I am Bhṛgu; among speeches the one imperishable syllable; among sacrifices the sacrifice of muttered prayer; among immovable things Himalaya.
